description: Published contact details for a company from its own website: reads the home page and up to four contact, about, support or imprint pages and returns the email addresses offered there (role addresses marked, with the page each came from), phone numbers, social profiles (LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, GitHub, TikTok, Telegram, Discord) and whether the domain accepts mail and through which provider. Staff directories are not read and nothing is guessed. $0.008; unreachable sites are not charged. Costs $0.008 USDC per call (x402).
name: contacts_find
title: contacts find
